layers.name: Controller
layers.description: Handles Request, Validation (inline), Auth checks via Spatie, and calls Inertia::render

layers.name: Model
layers.description: Eloquent Active Record. Repository pattern is NOT used.

layers.name: Inertia Middleware
layers.description: HandleInertiaRequests for shared state (Auth, Flash, Settings)

layers.name: React Page
layers.description: Code-splitted entry points passing data to Components

layers.name: React Components
layers.description: Atomic UI elements residing in resources/js/Components/UI

state_flow: Server -> HandleInertiaRequests -> Inertia -> React Props -> React Context
